caveats: Rate secondary (grade S): GST of 10% from VATCalc's 2026 table; ato.gov.au blocked automated fetches this session.
individualTaxYear runs 1 July to 30 June (grade I, inferred from the financial-year cycle; the ATO page was unreachable).
companyYearEndDefault is the 30 June financial-year end (grade I, the common Australian default; ASIC filings allow other dates).

Lower-bound rows - standard (2000-07-01), zero (2000-07-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (the OECD records the GST as introduced in 2000 at 10% and the cited secondary source marks its 25th anniversary in July 2025; no fetched source states the commencement day, so 1 July 2000 is the widely recorded date pending confirmation against the ATO).
